title_candidates: OpenAI's macOS app security cutoff is today
summary: June 12 is the cutoff for older OpenAI macOS desktop apps signed with outdated certificates after the TanStack supply-chain attack response.

primary_source.title: Our response to the TanStack npm supply chain attack
primary_source.author: OpenAI
key_facts: OpenAI set June 12, 2026 as the cutoff for older macOS desktop app versions signed with outdated certificates.
The action followed OpenAI's response to the TanStack npm supply-chain attack.
OpenAI said Windows and iOS users did not need to take action for this certificate rotation.

supporting_sources.title: TanStack Supply Chain Attack Hits Two OpenAI Employee Devices

prerequisites: A Mac with ChatGPT, Codex, or another OpenAI desktop app installed

steps.instruction: Update OpenAI macOS apps from the official app or website and remove old duplicate copies.
